I'm Sanskar, a software developer. I started planning this website in April 2026 and opened its current repository in September 2026.

I work on programming languages, developer tools, video editing software and other open-source projects. My interests extend from systems programming in Rust and C++ to Android, web development, games and machine learning.

This site is my own place to document those projects, publish technical writing and share the things I learn while building software.
